Definition: Achio, the name of three Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Ahio drove the new cart carrying the ark of God from the house of Abinadab, walking before it with Uzzah his brother, on the day David learned that good intentions do not make an unholy way holy.
TheologicalSignificance: Ahio himself is not judged in the text, and I will not judge him either. But the scene is a sober one: the ark was to be carried on priests' shoulders, not hauled on a cart, and the cost of forgetting that fell on the man beside him.
RelatedPeople: Ahio, Son of Abinadab; King David; Uzzah, Son of Abinadab
RelatedEvents: David Brings the Ark to Jerusalem
